chapters.name: Light - Reflection and Refraction
learning_outcomes: LO-2: Distinguish between real and virtual images
LO-3: Apply mirror formula and magnification
LO-4: Explain laws of refraction and refractive index
LO-5: Draw ray diagrams for spherical mirrors and lenses

chapters.name: Chemical Reactions and Equations
learning_outcomes: LO-1: Write and balance chemical equations
LO-2: Identify types of chemical reactions (combination, decomposition, displacement, double displacement)
LO-4: Describe effects of oxidation in everyday life (corrosion, rancidity)
